latest_release.name: Amethyst 0.25.0
latest_release.body:
# What's New
* Add option to start with tiling disabled. Thanks, @TheSynt4x!
* Add command for toggling sending windows to the main pane. Thanks, @rgeraskin!
* Fix an issue preventing interaction with Floating preferences. Thanks, @EhsanAzish80!
* Fix incorrect pointer conversion, which is a likely source of a variety of multi-display bugs. Thanks, @Possum!
* Fix a variety of other bugs, especially around proper reflows at the proper times. Thanks @mmv08, @farheinheigt, @pedrusck, and @djp3!

## What's Changed
* Amethyst 0.24.3 by @ianyh in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1852
* Upgrade Sparkle by @ianyh in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1874
* Fix unresponsive Floating preferences menu on Tahoe by @EhsanAzish80 in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1873
* Fix exponentiation in calculations by @pedrusck in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1863
* Avoid force unwrapping by @pedrusck in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1866
* Upgrade dependencies by @ianyh in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1897
* Add Send Window to Main Pane Toggle Hotkey and HUD by @rgeraskin in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1803
* Fix tiling after reopening apps that keep windows alive by @mmv08 in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1870
* Fix mouse window swapping across Spaces by @farheinheigt in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1879
* Add option to start with tiling disabled by @TheSynt4x in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1881
* Reflow the screen a window was thrown from by @djp3 in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1891
* Look up accessibility handlers through the application by @djp3 in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1889
* Move the start-with-tiling-disabled checkbox onto its own row by @djp3 in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1901
* Tests-only: Keep the custom layout tests independent of the window margin settings by @djp3 in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1902
* Place a window on the screen that shows its Space by @djp3 in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1899
* Fix pointer coordinate conversion with vertically offset displays by @Possum in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1905
* Remove MASShortcut by @ianyh in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1908

## New Contributors
* @EhsanAzish80 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1873
* @mmv08 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1870
* @farheinheigt made their first contribution in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1879
* @TheSynt4x made their first contribution in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1881
* @djp3 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1891
* @Possum made their first contribution in https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/pull/1905

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ianyh/Amethyst/compare/v0.24.3...v0.25.0b
